zones.title: Receive
zones.body: The gateway posts the end reason when the call drops or the transfer completes.

zones.title: Load state
zones.body: Prompts for the spoken lines; the session row decides the outcome.

zones.title: Outcome
zones.body: CaseOutcome in order: booked, moved or cancelled (Resolved, DealerBook sent the confirmation); callback logged (Delegated to XCCC); self-service (Resolved); ended in HANDOFF or a handoff end reason (Delegated); otherwise Closed.

zones.title: Close
zones.body: Chat memory purged, session finalised, end logged. Nothing of the call is retained beyond ar_events.

panels.title: AR-03 Session end
panels.body: Every journey ends with the case closed in CASE. The outcome comes from the session row; DealerBook confirms bookings, cancellations and moves to the customer, so nothing is sent from here. Chat memory for the session is deleted: no transcript survives the call.
